name: Terra Bacterias
startIntroPart1: Look at the state they’ve reduced the planet to... Are we going to let this happen? I highly doubt it.

name: Lovers of the Wall
startIntroPart1: How could they not love the walls that saved them from extinction? During the ceremony—which is a time of war—the people known as the Lovers of the Wall renew the walls and polish their weapons, ensuring they are in prime condition; after all, they would not want to ruin the ceremony.
startIntroPart2: The grandeur and majesty of those walls simply take my breath away! Huh? You were here too, my friend!? Come on, let's become a Steampunk legend!
declaringWar: It's sheer stupidity, unless you move the ships overland.
